answer_1.quote: LLMs may provide a means for lay readers to access such findings by automatically summarizing and simplifying texts into plain language.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate a suite of existing automatic factuality metrics shown to be effective in prior work. (1) Dependency-Arc Entailment (DAE) ... (2) QuestEval ... (3) QAFactEval ... (4) AlignScore

answer_3.quote: We prompt LLMs with instructions emulating the questions asked of human evaluators in FACTPICO.

answer_4.quote: FACTPICO was annotated by two senior students in their fifth year of medical school who are highly proficient in English.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are shown a 'source' input ... and asked a series of 7 questions for evaluation.
